Hello, PUBG Esports Fans!

PGS Circuit 3 is about to conclude with an explosive four days of PUBG esports action at **PGS 9**!

As the Circuit Final approaches, here’s what you need to know about the tournament format, where to watch, drops and more.

### Schedule

**Survival Stage**: August 20th

- Seeding for PGS 9 is based on teams’ performance in PGS 7 and 8. The Top 8 teams from those tournaments will bypass the Survival Stage and go directly to the Finals. Everyone else will duke it out in the 16-team Survival Stage on Thursday, in a last-chance dash to make it to the ultimate PGS Finals lobby. Only the Top 8 can advance from the Survival Stage!

**Grand Finals**: August 21st - 23rd

- A  no-holds-barred three day BO15 fight for the PGS Champion title. It’s the classic SUPER format you know and love - the team with the most points at the end of the third match day will be crowned the Champion. But since PGS 9 is the Circuit 3 Final, there’s a twist - the top performers in the PGS 7 & 8 Winner’s stage receive Advantage Points which are added to their standings at the start of the respective Final Stage.

Winners Stage Placement | 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th | 5th | 6th | 7th | 8th
Advantage Points | 10 | 6 | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 | 1
